# Ed Krystosik

> Builder, founder, and hands-on operator at the intersection of AI, biotech, and
> business strategy. CAIO at RAC/AI, co-founder of Audity, co-founder of Artana Bio,
> and Finance Director at the Med13 Foundation. Based in Reno, NV.

## About
- [Home (Markdown)](https://edkrystosik.com/index.md): full overview of who Ed is, his ventures, and background.
- [Contact / agent registration](https://edkrystosik.com/auth.md): how to reach Ed and how an agent should identify itself.

## Ventures
- [Audity](https://auditynow.com/audity-teams): the operating system for boutique AI consulting firms (3-25 people) running multi-seat client work. Ed is co-founder. $397/seat/mo.
- [RAC/AI](https://racprojects.ai/): AI transformation consulting and advisory for established mid-market businesses ($15K-$50K engagements). Ed is CAIO.
- Artana Bio: early-stage biotechnology and precision-medicine venture. Ed is co-founder.
- Med13 Foundation: nonprofit advancing medical research. Ed is Finance Director.
